podcast.body: This song by Gloria Jones was a significant Northern Soul hit in the mid-1960s, a type of music that found a dedicated audience and "a home" in cities like Manchester and Liverpool. "Gloria Jones with the kind of mid 60s soul music that found a home in places like Manchester and Liverpool."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music

podcast.body: Written by Ed Cobb, Gloria Jones released this song in May 1965 as the B-side to "My Bad Boys Come In Home," which was intended to be a major single. Both tracks flopped and the record disappeared until it was rediscovered years later by a British club DJ. "She released it in May 1965 as a B side to what was supposed to be a big single called My Bad Boys Come In Home."
